question: List all customer names and regions.
gold_sql: SELECT name, region FROM customers;

question: How many total customers are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers;

question: Show all customers located in the 'North' region.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name, region FROM customers WHERE region = 'North';

question: List all customers who do not have a region assigned.
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE region IS NULL;

question: How many total orders have been placed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders;

question: What is the total revenue collected across all orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders;

question: What is the average order total amount?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) AS avg_order_amount FROM orders;

question: Show the top 5 largest orders by total amount.
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all unique products sold in line items.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT product_name FROM line_items;

question: Count the total number of line items recorded.
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_line_items FROM line_items;

question: Which customer placed order ID 10?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.id = 10;

question: Show the customer name and total amount for each order.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.id AS order_id, o.total_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id;

question: How many orders were placed by each customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What is the total spending per customer?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Who are the top 5 spenders among all customers?
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Find all customers who have placed orders with total amount greater than 400.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.total_amount > 400;

question: List total order revenue grouped by customer region.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, SUM(o.total_amount) AS region_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region;

question: Show the number of orders placed in each region.
gold_sql: SELECT c.region, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.region;

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product?
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(qty) AS total_quantity FROM line_items GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC;

question: Calculate total revenue generated per product from line items.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(qty * unit_price) AS product_revenue FROM line_items GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY product_revenue DESC;

question: Which product has generated the highest revenue?
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(qty * unit_price) AS product_revenue FROM line_items GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY product_revenue DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show all orders placed in the year 2024.
gold_sql: SELECT id, cust_id, order_date, total_amount FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date <= '2024-12-31';

question: Find customers who have spent more than 1000 in total across all their orders.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING SUM(o.total_amount) > 1000;

question: List customers who have never placed an order.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id WHERE o.id IS NULL;

question: For each customer, list their name and the details of all line items they purchased.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, l.product_name, l.qty, l.unit_price FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id JOIN line_items l ON o.id = l.order_id;

question: Which customer bought the 'Laptop' product?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id JOIN line_items l ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE l.product_name = 'Laptop';

question: Calculate the total quantity of '4K Monitor' sold to customers in the 'North' region.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l.qty) AS total_monitors FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id JOIN line_items l ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE l.product_name = '4K Monitor' AND c.region = 'North';

question: Find the average price per unit for each product line.
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_unit_price FROM line_items GROUP BY product_name;

question: Show the customer name, order ID, and line item total cost for orders placed in the 'West' region.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, o.id AS order_id, (l.qty * l.unit_price) AS line_total FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id JOIN line_items l ON o.id = l.order_id WHERE c.region = 'West';

question: List the top 3 customers by number of distinct product types purchased.
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.product_name) AS distinct_products FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.cust_id JOIN line_items l ON o.id = l.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY distinct_products DESC LIMIT 3;
